description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for handling various forms of corruption in Git repositories, including corrupted objects, missing objects, misnamed objects, and various cloning and fetching scenarios involving corrupted repositories.

methods.name: obj_to_file
methods.description: Converts a Git object reference into the corresponding file path within the .git/objects directory.

methods.name: corrupt_byte
methods.description: Corrupts a specific byte in a given Git object file by overwriting it with a null byte.
